risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (358.56), flat yield curve, rising dollar, CPI event today, and earnings in 2 days create a severely adverse macro and event-risk environment for Financials.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish + squeeze positive + CMF cross-up with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 358.56) offers asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes post-CPI.
